text.tspan: LoadCredential=: RTT, CalDAV, ntfy and DB secrets
• Arrows show which side opens the connection.
• The service reaches ntfy and CalDAV by their public URLs, hairpinning through the router to NGINX.
• The gateway is the only internet-facing host; only 443/tcp is forwarded.
• Secrets live in /etc/uk-train-alerts/credentials/ and reach the service only via LoadCredential=.
• Run state lives in PostgreSQL; there is no /var/lib state on info. Time synchronisation is out of scope.
